textbookBox.concept: Kishan had 364 saplings and brought 52 more. We add 364 + 52 to find the total. We draw a box diagram. The whole is the long box, and the two parts are 364 and 52. We add ones first, 4 + 2 = 6.

beats.en: Kishan must send 230 saplings to a school, and he has packed 75 of them. How many more must he pack? We find 230 - 75. We cannot take 5 ones from 0 ones, so we open one ten into 10 ones.

textbookBox.concept: Kishan had 456 saplings and gave away 63. The box diagram shows 456 as the whole, so we subtract 456 - 63 = 393. He had 309 and got 80 more. 309 + 80 = 389.

beats.en: Kishan had 456 saplings and gave away 63. The box diagram shows 456 as the whole, so we subtract 456 - 63 = 393. He had 309 and got 80 more. 309 + 80 = 389. He has 270 herb saplings and his friend has 36.
